```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The road ahead for Afghanistan is still long and difficult.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Afghan people can know that their country will never be abandoned to terrorists and killers.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The world and the United States look forward to elections this year in Afghanistan.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States stands with the Afghan people as partners in their quest for peace and prosperity, stability, and democracy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans do not equivocate about whether America should have gone to war in Iraq.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The best intelligence available at the time indicated that Saddam Hussein was a threat.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"President Bush, members of both parties in Congress, and the United Nations agreed that Saddam Hussein was a threat.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Stockpiles of weapons of mass destruction expected to be found in Iraq have not yet materialized.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Saddam Hussein had the capability to reconstitute his weapons programs and the desire to do so.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States and its allies did the right thing by ending the brutal dictatorship of Saddam Hussein.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States and its allies halting Saddam Hussein's decades-long pursuit of chemical, biological, and nuclear weapons made the American people safer.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"President Bush chose to defend America rather than trust Saddam Hussein.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```

{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The road ahead for Afghanistan is still long and difficult.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Afghan people can know that their country will never be abandoned to terrorists and killers.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The world and the United States look forward to elections this year in Afghanistan.",

"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The best intelligence available at the time indicated that Saddam Hussein was a threat.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"President Bush, members of both parties in Congress, and the United Nations agreed that Saddam Hussein was a threat.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"While the stockpiles of weapons of mass destruction we expected to find in Iraq have not yet materialized, Saddam Hussein had the capability to reconstitute his weapons programs and the desire to do so.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States and its allies did the right thing, and the American people are now safer because the United States and its allies ended the brutal dictatorship of Saddam Hussein, halting his decades-long pursuit of chemical, biological, and nuclear weapons.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"President Bush had a choice to make: Trust a madman or defend America, and he chose defending America.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
